try-main.text: Florist, four shops. The flowers are the main products; Umbrella was added from “Add product”. Type a rate in its Supplies cell, step its machines, × removes it, “Add product” brings it back. Metal Wire and Plastic are the added line's raw material, new orders in Ingredients.

try-states.text: The range alone in each state. The picker lists what a Florist “can additionally sell”, by the game's weight.
